'''Cannibal Vampires''' are a vampire variant with all stats buffed by ~20% from the Original Vampire.

== Feeding ==
As a Cannibal Vampire, you may only feed on the blood of other vampires. Drinking any blood except vampires' blood has a 20% chance of turning you back into a normal vampire.

== How to Become One ==
Drink the blood of another vampire. Each time you bite them, there is a 5% chance you become a Cannibal Vampire.

== Strengths and Weaknesses ==
* '''Strengths:''' All stats buffed ~20% from the Original Vampire
* '''Weaknesses:''' Drinking non-vampire blood risks reverting to a normal vampire (20% chance); sunlight and stakes, as with other vampires
